summary: Practise portfolio return, risk, attribution, and Excel reporting methods. Explore the five-day investment analysis and reporting course.
lede: Investment performance analysis and reporting training helps analysts, portfolio managers, and fund accountants turn portfolio data into traceable reports. Participants practise reconciling holdings, transactions, and cash flows; calculating time- and money-weighted returns; measuring risk; and explaining results with Brinson-Fachler attribution and Excel dashboards. The course also covers benchmark selection, valuation reporting context under IFRS 9 and IFRS 13, and checks for AI-assisted commentary.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, or use investment performance analysis and portfolio reports.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with investment products, portfolio reporting, or financial statements is expected. Basic spreadsheet use is helpful. Coding is not required. Bring a laptop with access to Microsoft Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet application for calculation and dashboard exercises.
